feedback.problem:
What linear transformation is represented by the following matrix
$[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}]?$
feedback.worked_solution:
We can find the images of the standard basis vectors $i$ and $j$ under the action of  $T,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}T(i) & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=i \\ T(j) & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}]=4i+j\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the matrix represents a *horizontal* shear with a shear factor of $4.$

submitted_fields.submitted_value: A horizontal shear with a shear factor of $4$
